request.what: Fund a 12-month Governance Incentives Framework project to research, model, test, document, and submit a governance incentives framework for Cardano.

claims.claim: The project will evaluate candidate governance incentive mechanisms through research, data, modeling, controlled testing, and community input before presenting adoption decisions to governance.
Existing Cardano governance incentive work includes 49 relevant efforts, proposals, research papers, tools, and initiatives mapped by the Governance Incentives Working Group.
During Cardano's first year of on-chain governance, active DReps declined in every 12-epoch period, DRep voting-power concentration increased, and 11-16 DReps represented 51% of voting power.

The proposal argues that poor incentive design could reward surface-level activity, reinforce voting-power concentration, encourage gaming, or spend treasury resources without meaningful governance value.
The project will deliver seven staged milestones covering discovery, framework definition, data collection, modeling, dashboarding, validation, and governance integration.

The proposal sets measurable KPIs including 50+ governance actors engaged, 10+ workshops, 12 monthly updates, 50+ simulation scenarios, at least 99% monitoring service availability, and 5+ dashboards.
The team claims relevant Cardano and governance experience, including Catalyst closeouts, ambassador and committee roles, blockchain instruction, and prior governance incentives work.

The requested budget is ₳4,207,967 allocated across workstreams including modeling, research, administration, community engagement, data engineering, dashboarding, pilot, contingency, and audit oversight.
The detailed operational budget is maintained separately and the anchor document presents only workstream-level allocations.
The Website and Dashboard allocation covers 12 months of project delivery and six months of post-project maintenance.

summary: The document requests ₳4,207,967 for a 12-month R&D, modeling, pilot, data, dashboard, and governance-integration project intended to produce a Cardano Governance Incentives Framework and related public outputs.
